messages.subject: Pre-Summarized Data
parts:
Hey,

unfortunately I did not deal with ggplot2 for a while and now a friend
of mine wants to create a diagramm with pre-summarized data and I have
no clue how to handle it.

The Data Frame which I aggregated now looks like this :

Year Group Amount
2001 G1 43245
2002 G1 312321
2001 G2 432432
2002 G2 343243
2001 G3 3423
2002 G3 32

And I want to put the years in different facets, where the amount of
every group is displayed.

Unfortunately I have no clue how to deal with presummarized data in
ggplot2 :-(

Can anyone give an advice ?

Thank you very much and best regards,

Ed

messages.author: 66a7bbbceef834e9
messages.subject: Re: Pre-Summarized Data
parts:
Hi Ed, 

just add stat='identity', so the code looks like this:

qplot(Group, Amount, data=your_dataframe, geom='bar', stat='identity')+facet_wrap(~Year)

I hope it works for you.
Bye

2009/9/1 Ed <edve...@googlemail.com>
